package domain

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
)

type SandboxProvisionRequest struct {
	StudentID             string          `json:"user_id"`
	TaskID                string          `json:"task_id"`
	AnswerID              string          `json:"answer_id,omitempty"`
	ComposeConfig         json.RawMessage `json:"compose_config"`
	CodeStructureTypeCode string          `json:"code_structure_type_code"`
	CodeStructure         json.RawMessage `json:"code_structure"`
}

type SandboxSession struct {
	SandboxID  string `json:"sandbox_id"`
	PreviewURL string `json:"preview_url,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationTaskMetadata struct {
	TaskKind               string `json:"task_kind,omitempty"`
	ExecutionMode          string `json:"execution_mode,omitempty"`
	EvaluationMode         string `json:"evaluation_mode,omitempty"`
	SubmissionMode         string `json:"submission_mode,omitempty"`
	SupportsLiveValidation bool   `json:"supports_live_validation,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationRunRequest struct {
	TaskID                string                 `json:"task_id"`
	CodeStructureTypeCode string                 `json:"code_structure_type_code,omitempty"`
	Mode                  string                 `json:"mode,omitempty"`
	CodeStructure         json.RawMessage        `json:"code_structure"`
	WorkspaceFiles        []WorkspaceFile        `json:"workspace_files,omitempty"`
	TaskMetadata          ValidationTaskMetadata `json:"task_metadata,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationRunResult struct {
	ContractKind    string               `json:"contract_kind"`
	ContractVersion int                  `json:"contract_version"`
	Legacy          bool                 `json:"legacy"`
	Passed          bool                 `json:"passed"`
	Stages          []ValidationStageRun `json:"stages,omitempty"`
	Links           []ValidationLinkRun  `json:"links,omitempty"`
	Errors          []ValidationRunIssue `json:"errors,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationStageRun struct {
	StageID  string               `json:"stage_id"`
	Engine   string               `json:"engine"`
	Status   string               `json:"status"`
	Passed   bool                 `json:"passed"`
	Optional bool                 `json:"optional"`
	Duration int64                `json:"duration_ms"`
	Evidence []ValidationRunPoint `json:"evidence,omitempty"`
	Errors   []ValidationRunIssue `json:"errors,omitempty"`
	Warnings []ValidationRunIssue `json:"warnings,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationLinkRun struct {
	LinkID   string               `json:"link_id"`
	Kind     string               `json:"kind"`
	Status   string               `json:"status"`
	Passed   bool                 `json:"passed"`
	Optional bool                 `json:"optional"`
	Errors   []ValidationRunIssue `json:"errors,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationRunIssue struct {
	Code     string `json:"code"`
	Message  string `json:"message"`
	Severity string `json:"severity,omitempty"`
	StageID  string `json:"stage_id,omitempty"`
	Engine   string `json:"engine,omitempty"`
	File     string `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Selector string `json:"selector,omitempty"`
	Route    string `json:"route,omitempty"`
	Symbol   string `json:"symbol,omitempty"`
	Property string `json:"property,omitempty"`
	Hint     string `json:"hint,omitempty"`
	Line     int    `json:"line,omitempty"`
	Column   int    `json:"column,omitempty"`
}

type ValidationRunPoint struct {
	File     string `json:"file,omitempty"`
	Selector string `json:"selector,omitempty"`
	Route    string `json:"route,omitempty"`
	Symbol   string `json:"symbol,omitempty"`
	Property string `json:"property,omitempty"`
	Message  string `json:"message,omitempty"`
}

type SandboxRuntimeClient interface {
	CreateOrResumeSandbox(ctx context.Context, request SandboxProvisionRequest) (*SandboxSession, error)
	CreateFile(ctx context.Context, sandboxID, studentID, path, content string) error
	GetSnapshot(ctx context.Context, sandboxID string) ([]WorkspaceFile, error)
}

type ValidationRuntimeClient interface {
	Validate(ctx context.Context, request ValidationRunRequest) (*ValidationRunResult, error)
}
